processing.name: Indore–Dewas Solvent Extraction Super-Cluster (Madhya Pradesh)
products: Strategic Role: Globally recognized as the processing, financial price-discovery, and trade headquarters of the Indian soybean economy.
catchment: Catchment Areas: The entire Malwa plateau and Narmada basin: Ujjain, Dewas, Dhar, Indore, Ratlam, Shajapur, Sehore, Hoshangabad, Harda, and cross-border rail receipts from Kota and Baran (Rajasthan).

paragraphs.text: Strategic Role: Globally recognized as the processing, financial price-discovery, and trade headquarters of the Indian soybean economy.

Key Facilities: Over 80 continuous-extraction solvent plants, vegetable oil refineries, texturized soy extrusion units, and lecithin drying operations located in Indore, Dewas, Pithampur Industrial Area, Ujjain, and Mandideep (Bhopal); host to the SOPA physical trading registry and advanced NABL-certified analytical laboratories testing for Non-GMO compliance, protein solubility, and chemical residues.
Catchment Areas: The entire Malwa plateau and Narmada basin: Ujjain, Dewas, Dhar, Indore, Ratlam, Shajapur, Sehore, Hoshangabad, Harda, and cross-border rail receipts from Kota and Baran (Rajasthan).

protection.name: Girdle Beetle (Oberioides brevis)
protection.geography: All-India Commercial Belts (Heavy in MP, Maharashtra, Rajasthan)
protection.impact: Adult female beetle cuts two parallel circular girdles (rings) around the main stem or petiole, laying an egg between them; the plant tissue above the girdle wilts, dries up, and droops like an umbrella handle; hatching grub bores down the center of the stem, hollowing the pith; causes 20–40% field yield loss.
protection.passage: Soybean — source table 166, row 2. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Stem Fly (Melanagromyza sojae)
protection.geography: Early Vegetative to Branching (All Commercial Belts)
protection.impact: Tiny female fly inserts eggs into young leaf tissues; maggots bore through the petiole into the main stem; feeding zigzags down the pith; vascular tissues rot; damaged stems split easily, leaves wilt, and plants become severely stunted; causes 15–35% mortality.
protection.passage: Soybean — source table 166, row 3. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Mungbean Yellow Mosaic India Virus (MYMIV) (Transmitted by Whitefly Bemisia tabaci)
protection.geography: Humid Monsoon Intervals (Devastating in North & Central Belts)
protection.impact: Young leaves develop irregular, bright yellow chlorotic spots; spots coalesce, turning the entire canopy brilliant golden-yellow ("Yellow Mosaic"); plants become stunted, flowers abort, and pods remain small, deformed, and seedless; causes 30–80% yield loss.
protection.passage: Soybean — source table 166, row 4. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Defoliator Complex: Tobacco Caterpillar & Green Semilooper (Spodoptera litura, Chrysodeixis acuta)
protection.impact: Gregarious Spodoptera larvae skeletonize leaves, leaving only veins; older larvae chew large holes in leaves and bore into developing green pods; semiloopers chew foliage, causing severe canopy loss.
protection.passage: Soybean — source table 166, row 5. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Charcoal Rot & Collar Rot (Macrophomina phaseolina, Sclerotium rolfsii)
protection.impact: Water-soaked rot at the ground collar of seedlings; plants wilt and topple; post-flowering drought induces charcoal rot: lower stems show grey-black discoloration, the bark shreds, and the split stem reveals tiny black sclerotial bodies; plants lodge completely.
protection.passage: Soybean — source table 166, row 6. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.

protection.name: Soybean Rust (Phakopsora pachyrhizi)
protection.geography: Warm, Dewy Late Kharif (Heavy in Maharashtra, Karnataka)
protection.impact: Minute, chlorotic spots appear on leaf undersides, developing into reddish-brown to tan pustules (uredinia); pustules rupture, shedding powdery spores; spreads across the canopy, causing premature leaf yellowing and complete defoliation ("leaf burn"); reduces seed weight by 30–80%.
protection.passage: Soybean — source table 166, row 7. Management modes are descriptive; formulations, rates and schedules omitted.
